title: ☁️ Kiran's free cloud storage filled in weeks... the setting to change #cloudstorage #videobackup
title_alts: 📹 Kiran's cloud plan counts bytes, not pictures... what really fills it #cloudstorage #videobackup
🛑 Kiran backed up every clip he filmed... the upload rule to set first #cloudstorage #phonestorage
description_hook: A free cloud plan does not count your photos. It counts bytes, and video carries most of them.
setting: a home desk with a phone and a laptop

characters.name: Kiran
characters.description: late twenties, short black hair, plain grey t-shirt, always carries a small clip-on microphone

scenes.narration: One minute of 4K video eats about 350 megabytes.
scenes.caption: 4K वीडियो का ऐक मिनट करीब 350 मेगाबाइट खा जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: A single phone resting on a light wooden desk, its bright screen filled by one large video thumbnail, morning light falling across the grain

scenes.narration: Kiran's free fifteen gigabytes lasted years on photos alone.
scenes.caption: किरण के फ़्री पंद्रह जीबी सिर्फ़ फ़ोटो से सालों चलते रहे।
scenes.image_brief: A tall storage meter on a phone screen, its coloured portion filling only a thin slice at the bottom and the rest empty grey, cool even light

scenes.narration: Then he started filming. The space vanished in one month.
scenes.caption: फिर उसने वीडियो बनाना शुरू किया। जगह ऐक महीने में ख़त्म।
scenes.image_brief: The same tall storage meter now coloured almost to the top with a sliver of grey left, the phone propped against a stack of books, warm lamp light

scenes.narration: Here is what really fills a cloud plan, and what does not.
scenes.caption: समझिये कि क्लाउड प्लान असल में क्या भरता है, और क्या नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: Two neat piles side by side on a dark desk: a small stack of printed photographs and one film clapper board, soft overhead light

scenes.narration: Cloud storage charges you for bytes stored, not files counted.
scenes.caption: क्लाउड स्टोरेज फ़ाइलों की गिनती नहीं, बाइट्स का हिसाब रखता है।
scenes.image_brief: A transparent glass jar half filled with identical small cubes, a measuring scale printed up its side, plain background, flat daylight

scenes.narration: A video stores dozens of frames every second. A photo stores one.
scenes.caption: वीडियो हर सेकंड दर्जनों फ्रेम रखता है। फ़ोटो सिर्फ़ ऐक।
scenes.image_brief: A filmstrip unrolled across a table showing dozens of tiny identical frames, and beside it one single printed photograph, soft side light

scenes.narration: So fifteen gigabytes holds roughly forty minutes of 4K footage.
scenes.caption: तो पंद्रह जीबी में 4K का करीब चालीस मिनट ही समाता है।
scenes.image_brief: A wall clock on a shelf with a forty minute arc of its face marked in bright tape, a small camera standing beside it, warm light

scenes.narration: The same space holds about five thousand phone photos. Same bytes.
scenes.caption: उतनी ही जगह में लगभग पाँच हज़ार फ़ोटो समा जाती हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A huge fan of printed photographs spread across a floor, so many that they overlap in layers, even daylight from above

scenes.narration: Switching backup to saver quality shrinks photos, not video length.
scenes.caption: सेवर क्वालिटी फ़ोटो को छोटा करती है, वीडियो की लंबाई नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A phone settings screen showing two quality options drawn as two rectangles of different size, the smaller one marked with a tick, cool light

scenes.narration: And screen recordings count too. Many people forget those entirely.
scenes.caption: स्क्रीन रिकॉर्डिंग भी गिनी जाती है। लोग उसे भूल जाते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop screen displaying a long list of identically sized recording files with a screen recording symbol in the corner, dim room light

scenes.narration: Your plan is not filling because you take too many pictures.
scenes.caption: प्लान इसलिए नहीं भरा कि आपने बहुत फ़ोटो खींच लीं।
scenes.image_brief: A tablet screen showing a tidy grid of hundreds of small uniform photo thumbnails, cool daylight on a kitchen table

scenes.narration: A few long clips outweigh a whole year of photos.
scenes.caption: कुछ लंबी क्लिप पूरे साल की फ़ोटो से भारी पड़ती हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A balance scale on a wooden table where one pan holding three short film strips sinks low and the other holding a thick stack of photo prints lifts high, soft window light

scenes.narration: Open your storage screen and sort by size, largest first.
scenes.caption: स्टोरेज स्क्रीन खोलें और साइज़ से सॉर्ट करें, बड़ी फ़ाइल पहले।
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen showing a file list where the top item is a wide bar and the rest are thin bars, lying on a desk under a warm lamp glow

claims.claim: One minute of 4K video eats about 350 megabytes.
claims.basis: typical phone 4K bitrate; round illustrative assumption, narrated as approximate

claims.claim: Kiran's free fifteen gigabytes lasted years on photos alone.
claims.basis: fifteen gigabytes is a common free consumer tier; round illustrative figure

claims.claim: So fifteen gigabytes holds roughly forty minutes of 4K footage.
claims.basis: arithmetic from the stated figures: 15000 MB divided by 350 MB per minute is about 43

claims.claim: The same space holds about five thousand phone photos.
claims.basis: assumes roughly three megabytes per photo, a round illustrative assumption

title: 🗑️ Anaya's cloud bin still charges her... the second delete nobody does #cloudstorage #storagefull
title_alts: ♻️ Anaya's deleted photos sit in a cloud bin... what that bin costs #cloudstorage #storagefull
⚠️ Anaya emptied her cloud bin blind... the list to read first #cloudstorage #filerecovery
description_hook: Deleting from the cloud does not free space straight away. The bin keeps the bytes, and the bill.
setting: a kitchen counter and a laptop at night

characters.name: Anaya
characters.description: early thirties, long dark plaited hair, mustard cardigan, reading glasses pushed up on her head

scenes.narration: Deleted cloud files keep using your paid space for thirty days.
scenes.caption: क्लाउड से हटाई फ़ाइलें तीस दिन तक आपकी जगह घेरती रहती हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A recycle bin symbol glowing on a laptop screen in a dark room, the bin drawn visibly overflowing, blue light spilling onto the desk

scenes.narration: Anaya cleared four thousand photos and the full-storage warning stayed.
scenes.caption: अनाया ने चार हज़ार फ़ोटो हटाईं, फिर भी स्टोरेज फ़ुल की सूचना रही।
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen showing a storage warning banner stretched across the top of a photo grid, daylight on a kitchen counter

scenes.narration: Her storage bar had not moved one pixel. Nothing changed.
scenes.caption: स्टोरेज बार ऐक पिक्सल भी नहीं हिला। कुछ नहीं बदला।
scenes.image_brief: A storage meter filling the whole width of a phone screen, solid colour end to end with no grey left, plain pale background

scenes.narration: Cloud deleting happens twice. Most people only ever do it once.
scenes.caption: क्लाउड में डिलीट दो बार होता है। लोग सिर्फ़ ऐक बार करते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Two identical grey rubbish bins standing side by side on a plain floor, one lid open and one lid shut, even light

scenes.narration: A delete moves the file into a recycle bin instead. Nothing leaves.
scenes.caption: डिलीट फ़ाइल को रीसायकल बिन में डाल देता है। बाहर कुछ नहीं जाता।
scenes.image_brief: A cardboard box marked with a bin symbol standing in a warehouse aisle with papers stacked neatly inside it, cool overhead lighting

scenes.narration: The bytes still sit on the provider's disks. So they still count.
scenes.caption: बाइट्स कंपनी की डिस्क पर बनी रहती हैं। इसलिए गिनती में रहती हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Rows of dark server racks in a data hall with small blue indicator lights, one rack door open showing stacked drives, cool blue light

scenes.narration: Four thousand photos at three megabytes each is twelve gigabytes, still billed to her.
scenes.caption: चार हज़ार फ़ोटो, तीन ऐमबी हर ऐक, यानी बारह जीबी अब भी बिल में।
scenes.image_brief: Four tall bundles of printed photographs stacked on a weighing scale whose needle is pushed well past the middle, plain table, soft light

scenes.narration: Emptying that bin is final. No support desk can reverse it later.
scenes.caption: बिन खाली करना आख़िरी है। कोई सपोर्ट उसे वापस नहीं ला पाएगा।
scenes.image_brief: A single red confirmation button glowing on a laptop screen with a paper shredder standing under the desk, warm dim room light

scenes.narration: Read the list before you confirm. Old shared albums hide in there.
scenes.caption: कन्फ़र्म से पहले सूची पढ़ें। पुराने शेयर ऐल्बम वहीं छिपे होते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A tablet screen inside a bin view showing a scrolling list of shared album covers, some covers faded and grey, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Her plan was never full. It was quietly holding her rubbish.
scenes.caption: उसका प्लान भरा ही नहीं था। वो उसका कचरा संभाल रहा था।
scenes.image_brief: The same phone storage meter now mostly empty grey with a small coloured slice at the start, the phone on a tidy desk, morning light

scenes.narration: Open your cloud bin today and clear out the oldest page first.
scenes.caption: आज अपना क्लाउड बिन खोलें और सबसे पुराना पेज पहले साफ़ करें।
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen open on a bin folder sorted oldest first, a thin scrollbar at the top of a very long list, warm lamp light beside a cup of tea

claims.claim: Deleted cloud files keep using your paid space for thirty days.
claims.basis: thirty days is the common consumer bin retention window; round illustrative figure

claims.claim: Anaya cleared four thousand photos and the full-storage warning stayed.
claims.basis: illustrative count chosen for the worked example

claims.claim: Four thousand photos at three megabytes each is twelve gigabytes, still billed to her.
claims.basis: arithmetic from the stated count and the stated three megabytes per photo
